images.filename: A-7E Corsair II takes off from NAF El Centro 1991.JPEG
images.caption: A U.S. Navy LTV A-7E Corsair II of Attack Squadron VA-122 "Flying Eagles" takes off on a training mission from Naval Air Facility El Centro, California (USA), on 6 February 1991. VA-122 was the U.S. Navy's last A-7 fleet replacement training squadron and was disestablished on 31 May 1991.
images.alt: A U.S. Navy LTV A-7E Corsair II of Attack Squadron VA-122 "Flying Eagles" takes off on a training mission from Naval Air Facility El Centro, California (USA), on 6 February 1991. VA-122 was the U.S. Navy's last A-7 fleet replacement training squadron and was disestablished on 31 May 1991.

images.caption:
A UH-1Y Venom, top, and a AH-1W Super Cobra, bottom, both with Marine Light Attack Helicopter Squadron 369, land at a forward area refueling point during Operation Desert Tantrum outside of El Centro, Calif., March, 14. The exercise allowed HMLA-369 to carry out crucial training while their usual refueling zone was taken.

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Christopher Johns)
